profile.summary: A nonprofit community health center and Federally Qualified Health Center in the Bay Area that serves American Indians, Alaska Natives and the surrounding community. It offers medical, dental, behavioral health, community wellness and social services at sites in three counties, including school-based health centers.

review.notes: ProPublica, the organization's About and Locations pages, and OUSD's UFSA page confirm an Oakland 501(c)(3) FQHC that runs a school-based health center for OUSD students, matching the no-cost SBHC MOU. Summary, address, phone, EIN and website are all supported and neutral.
